notes.title: Weekend Update (Late!)
notes.notes:
It's Late, but its Great
And no-one is watching the calendar. I worked all weekend instead of being a party animal (wolf). Enjoy :)

Patch Notes

 Enhanced EXP Gems to reduce lag
 EXP Gem animation can be turned off
 Bloom, Explosion Opacity settings
 Floating Text Opacity and On/Off Settings per area
 New Run Animation!
 Better Camera System!
 Spawning back in lobby after death is no longer wonky!
 And you will spawn back in the stronghold
 Crouch, Dash, Werewolf indicators on main HUD
 Fixed Some text around the UIs
 Fixed the Butchers going under walls
 A bunch of little things everywhere

notes.title: Version 1.1 Release
notes.notes:
First Quarter Update, We'reWolves v1.1
Dash Dodge
Press "Shift" when you have enough stamina to quickly zip across the map.
During the Dash Dodge, collision and incoming are removed. This should help get you out of crowds that have you stuck bleeding out.

Stamina
In order to facilitate a full Dash Dodge experience, I had to add Stamina, a Stamina Bar, Recovery Rates, and all the other little pieces. To upgrade your Dash experience, see the Trainer at Beasthaven Stronghold.

Smoother Camera
The camera felt jittery at times, blurring some backgrounds and making certain animations jump.
I have rebuilt the camera logic to smoothly follow the player. This removes the jarring effects of being knocked back a large distance quickly; or when you dash across the field.

Visual Enhancements
There were a lot of hard to read text components, floating text was a bit messy, UI needed some rework, Settings page kept resetting, etc. That should all be fixed and pleasant now.

There are a lot of other tweaks in this build and from the mini-patch a few days ago. Leveling should be much easier in the higher levels now, and mobility was drastically increased with a few changes to collision. An example: when enemies die, the collision is immediately turned off so you can get through the crowd of dead bears.

Up Next:
New Tiles to the original three maps
New Map
New Level Ender Boss (Skeleton King)
Testing a Multiplayer Mode

notes.title: Weapon Balancing and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Spent some time ensuring that weapons were properly balanced, as they were all off after fixing a deeper mechanical issue in damage calculations.

Sword and Shield buffs and bonuses are now tied to having a cosmetic shield or two-hander.

A bunch of little bug fixes and optimizations.
